description: FREE headline check of whether your own website can be found, read, and acted on by AI agents (100/day per wallet; pass caller). Submit your site's URL; get the verdict line, readiness score, and which of the nine criteria are present/misshaped/absent. Evidence and the fix list are in the paid report. The audit grades fetched machine-readiness signals only — it does not certify the business, its safety, or its honesty.
